body.p: The following remarks are made in response to the Action. In this Response, claims 1 and 10 have been amended. No claims have been canceled or newly added. Claims 1-4, 6, and 8-10 are pending. The claim amendments are supported by at least, for example, paragraph [0036] of the Specification as filed. There is no new matter.

In view of the Request for Continued Examination ("RCE") filed concurrently, Applicant replaces the amendments made in the Response to the Final Office Action filed on September 3, 2024, with the above amendments. As such, markings of the above claims assume the previous amendment was not entered.
Claims 1-4, 6, and 8-10 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over CN 208645329 ("Pei"). Applicant traverses the rejections.

Without acquiescing to the propriety of the rejection, and to expedite prosecution, claim 1 has been amended to recite, "wherein the output of the second stage reduction assembly is adapted to engage with the input of the second stage reduction assembly to cause a rotation of the first arm link about the first axis by driving the hollow shaft about the first axis." The Action states that Pei teaches "a first arm link (30); a hollow shaft (29) extending along a first axis (axis of 29)." (Action at p. 2.) The Action also states that Pei teaches "a second stage reduction assembly (23, 24, 25)" and that "the output of the second stage reduction assembly is adapted (via belt 24) to engage with the input [23] of the second stage reduction assembly to cause a rotation of the first arm link (relative to the second link) via the hollow shaft [29] about the first axis [axis of 29]." (Action at p. 3.) For at least the below reasons, Pei does not teach the above recited feature of amended claim 1.
The following remarks are made in reference to annotated FIG. 2 of Pei below:

Pei does not teach the "driven pulley 25" of the "second cantilever drive device" is "adapted to engage" with the "driving pulley 23" of the "second cantilever drive device" to cause a rotation of the "second cantilever 30" about the axis of the "input shaft [29]"

by driving the "input shaft [29]" about its axis," as recited in amended claim 1. Instead, in Pei and as shown in FIG. 2, the "driven pulley 25 is fixed to the "input shaft [29]," and the "input shaft [29] of the hollow cycloidal reducer 22 is driven by the servo motor 21"
to cause the "first cantilever 20" to rotate about the axis of "input shaft [29]."

Moreover, Pei does not teach the rotation of the "input shaft [29]" of the "hollow cycloid reducer 22" causes rotation of the "second cantilever 30" about the axis of the "input shaft [29]." In Pei, the "second cantilever 30" does not teach being fixed to the "input shaft [29]" of the "hollow cycloid reducer 22." Instead, in Pei and as shown in FIG. 2, "the rear end 38 of the second cantilever 30 is fixed to the hollow cycloidal pinion[ o]n the output shaft of machine 22." Therefore, in Pei, the rotation of the "input shaft [29]" of the "hollow cycloid reducer 22" by operation of the "servo motor 21" does not teach the rotation of the "hollow cycloidal pinion" of the "output shaft" of "hollow cycloid reducer 22." Therefore, Pei does not teach the operation of the "servo motor 21" causes the "second cantilever 30" that is fixed to the "hollow cycloidal pinion" of the "output shaft of machine 22" to rotate about the axis of the "input shaft [29]."

Instead, Pei teaches the "second cantilever 30 includes ... a rotation mechanism 40," and that the "rotating mechanism 40 includes a rotary electric machine 41, a planetary gear reducer 42, a third toothed belt transmission, a spline shaft 43, and a spline sleeve 44." (Pei at p. 4 of machine translation.) In Pei, the "second cantilever 30" rotates about the axis of the "spline shaft 43," by operation of the "rotary electric machine 41" and the "third toothed belt transmission." Therefore, Pei does not teach the "driving pulley 23" is "adapted to engage" with the "driven pulley 25" of the "second cantilever drive device" to cause a rotation of the "second cantilever 30" about the axis of the "input shaft
[29]" by driving the "input shaft [29]" about its axis," as recited in amended claim 1.

Claim 1 further recites, "a hollow shaft extending along a first axis thereof and coupled to the first arm link," and "a second arm link connected to the hollow shaft." The Action states that Pei teaches a "hollow shaft (29) extending along a first axis (axis of 29) thereof and coupled to the first arm link, [and] providing a second arm link (20) connected to the hollow shaft." (Action at p. 2.) For similar reasons as those stated above, Pei does not teach this feature of claim 1.

Specifically, in Pei, the "input shaft [29]" of the "hollow cycloidal reducer 22" does not teach being coupled to the "second cantilever 30" and connected to the "first cantilever 20," as recited in claim 1. Instead, in Pei, "the rear end 38 of the second cantilever 30 is fixed to the hollow cycloidal pinion[ o]n the output shaft of machine 22." Therefore, Pei does not teach the "second cantilever 30" is coupled to the "input shaft 29." Thus, Pei does not teach "a hollow shaft extending along a first axis thereof and coupled to the first arm link," and "a second arm link connected to the hollow shaft," as recited in claim 1.

For at least the above reasons, independent claim 1 and its dependent claims 2- 4, 6, 8, and 9 are patentable over Pei. Although different in scope, independent claim 10 is patentable for similar reasons as claim 1. Applicant does not concede the correctness of the rejection with respect to features not discussed herein. Applicant requests favorable reconsideration of the claims and withdrawal of the rejection.

It is submitted that the rejections in the Action have been successfully traversed and that the application is now in condition for allowance. Reconsideration of the application and allowance thereof is solicited.

It is believed that all the pending claims have been addressed. However, the absence of a reply to a specific allegation or comment of the Action does not signify agreement or concession with that part. Also, the arguments herein are not exhaustive. The amendment or cancelation of a claim or other part of the Specification does not necessarily signify concession with an allegation or comment of the Action. Applicant reserves the right to prosecute the rejected claims in further prosecution of this or related applications.
